 \\\\                                Armor                                \\\\
  \\\\_____________________________________________________________________\\\\
   ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Listed below is all of the armor in the game, listed in the same order the
game has them listed, which is the following order:

 - Male-equippable, weakest to strongest.
 - Female-equippable, weakest to strongest.
 - Character-specific best armor, in order of when the characters joined.


.—————————————————————.—————————————.—————————————.———————————————————————————.
|  Armor              | P-Def/S-Def | P-Avd/S-Avd | Who can equip?            |
'—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————.

.—————————————————————.—————————————.—————————————.———————————————————————————.
|  Cotton Shirt       |    0 /   0  |    0 /   0  | Men                       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Cotton Shirt. Rugged but easy to move around in.       |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Cotton Shirt                                           |
|                      A manly cotton shirt. Easy to move around in but very  |
|                      rugged. Real adventurers look great in simple          |
|                      designs.                                               |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Leather Vest       |   10 /  10  |    1 /   1  | Men                       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A vest made of tanned leather.                         |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Leather Vest                                           |
|                      A vest made from the carefully tanned hide of a        |
|                      southern steer. Perfect for the male adventurer who    |
|                      swears by leather for battle. Don't get it wet.        |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Studded Harness    |   21 /  19  |    2 /   2  | Men                       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A harness studded with rivets.                         |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Studded Harness                                        |
|                      A harness sold off by the special airborne troops of   |
|                      a certain country. A wonderful bargain. Too heave and  |
|                      big for women, but dangerously attractive when worn    |
|                      on bare skin by men.                                   |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Chainmail Vest     |   36 /  34  |    4 /   3  | Men                       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): The ever-popular chainmail.                            |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Chainmail Vest                                         |
|                      A chainmail vest for men. With its powerful defensive  |
|                      properties, it doesn't allow blades or bullets         |
|                      through. It may be plain, but one day you'll be glad   |
|                      you wore it.                                           |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  RedLeatherJacket   |   58 /  55  |    5 /   5  | Men                       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A red leather jacket for one hot dude.                 |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Red Leather Jacket                                     |
|                      Three times more expensive than the mass-produced      |
|                      kind, these jackets are all custom made. They are      |
|                      lined with rubber to absorb impact.                    |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Stygian Robe       |   71 /  69  |    7 /   8  | Men                       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Battle gear to challenge the toughest monsters.        |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Stygian Robe                                           |
|                      A spiritual robe worn by warlocks when confronting     |
|                      evil. A bit costly, but offers excellent protection.   |
|                      Woven from superfine silk thread, it's light and has   |
|                      a unique sheen.                                        |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Cotton Blouse      |    0 /   0  |    0 /   0  | Women                     |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A cute cotton blouse.                                  |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Cotton Blouse                                          |
|                      A plain white blouse, the image of female purity.      |
|                      Young ladies look quite sharp in them. Older women     |
|                      appear quite authoritative.                            |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Leather Skirt      |    9 /  11  |    1 /   1  | Women                     |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A cool-looking leather skirt.                          |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Leather Skirt                                          |
|                      A pocketless leather miniskirt made from southern      |
|                      cowhide. It's easy to move around in, provides strong  |
|                      defense and looks great! A friend to fighting women    |
|                      everywhere.                                            |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Studded Bustier    |   19 /  21  |    2 /   2  | Women                     |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A bustier covered with glittering studs.               |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Studded Bustier                                        |
|                      Chic, a studded bustier designed for defense as well   |
|                      as good looks. Although lightweight, it is still       |
|                      somewhat cumbersome to move around in.                 |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Silk Bolero        |   34 /  36  |    3 /   4  | Women                     |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A beautiful, expensive silk bolero.                    |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Silk Bolero                                            |
|                      A bolero for the rich, active young lady. Made of the  |
|                      finest silk that has undergone a mystical process.     |
|                      Changes colors depending on how the light hits it.     |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Jasper Cape        |   56 /  57  |    5 /   5  | Women                     |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A blue cape that glitters faintly.                     |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Jasper Cape                                            |
|                      A tough cape of blue cloth, it reduces the chance of   |
|                      serious injury. Similar to the battle gear worn by     |
|                      the women of the Rose Croix on their journey to Rome.  |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Snow-White Robe    |   69 /  71  |    8 /   7  | Women                     |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A robe with strong defense against evil spirits.       |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Snow-White Robe                                        |
|                      Holy robe worn by white witches during ceremonies to   |
|                      ward off evil, it is a powerful defense against        |
|                      envoys from the demonic world and is proof of high     |
|                      rank as a psychic medium.                              |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Heretic's Coat     |   76 /  74  |   10 /  11  | Yuri                      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Coat well-suited to a destroyer of the gods.           |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Heretic's Coat                                         |
|                      A coat overflowing with supernatural power. Only       |
|                      those given the power to defy the gods can wear it.    |
|                      No one has yet been able to put it on. Cuts Darkness   |
|                      damage in half.                                        |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Father's Coat      |   83 /  77  |   15 /  11  | Yuri                      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): The beloved coat Father used to wear.                  |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Father's Coat                                          |
|                      Coat of legendary import in the Imperial Army. Worn    |
|                      by Colonel Ben Hyuga, known as "the God of Secret      |
|                      Intelligence". Cuts Darkness/Light damage in half.     |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  SilverThreadCoat   |   72 /  78  |   11 /  10  | Alice                     |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Rose embroidered with symbols of nobility.             |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Silver-Threaded Coat                                   |
|                      A spiritual robe blessed by a holy woman. The velvet   |
|                      background is embroidered with ancient symbols. It     |
|                      has powerful defensive properties, and cuts Light      |
|                      damage in half.                                        |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  GoldThreadCoat     |   74 /  86  |   11 /  15  | Alice                     |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Robe with symbols of truth and suffering.              |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Gold-Threaded Coat                                     |
|                      A long robe filled with the memories of martyrs past.  |
|                      The wearer feels as if he is wrapped in a warm light.  |
|                      Embroidered with ancient symbols, it cuts              |
|                      Light/Darkness damage in half.                         |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Coat of the Sage   |   71 /  79  |   10 /  11  | Zhuzhen                   |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): The short coat of a sage.                              |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Coat of the Sage                                       |
|                      A sage's short coat, worn only by the highest-level    |
|                      Taoist Adepts. Those without spiritual power cannot    |
|                      touch it. Cuts Fire damage in half.                    |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  CoatOfTheAdept     |   76 /  84  |   11 /  15  | Zhuzhen                   |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A short coat woven by Qiuhua.                          |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Coat of the Adept                                      |
|                      A short coat woven by Qiuhua, with the soul of a       |
|                      young girl. "Sniff sniff...Oh, It smells like          |
|                      Shanghai". The wearer is filled with energy. Cuts      |
|                      Fire and Water damage in half.                         |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Rubber Suit        |   75 /  75  |   11 /  10  | Margarete                 |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): For adults only?                                       |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Rubber Suit                                            |
|                      Suit make of thick rubber, its design is popular with  |
|                      "those" types. Originally a combat uniform for female  |
|                      members of a special assassination team. Cuts Water    |
|                      damage in half.                                        |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Leather Suit       |   81 /  79  |   14 /  12  | Margarete                 |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): For adults only!                                       |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Leather Suit                                           |
|                      Protective gear custom-made for the killer queen,      |
|                      Malkovich, who declared, "No Rubber Suit for me!"      |
|                      Cuts Fire and Water damage in half. "Not bad", she     |
|                      says.                                                  |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Mant.OfNobility    |   78 /  72  |   10 /  11  | Keith                     |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Proof of noble rank in the Darkness Clan.              |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Mantle of Nobility                                     |
|                      A silk mantle that shows high rank in the Darkness     |
|                      Clan. Lined with the scalps of sacrificed clergymen,   |
|                      the wearer feels wrapped in night itself. Cuts Earth   |
|                      damage in half.                                        |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Mant.OfShivering   |   87 /  73  |   14 /  12  | Keith                     |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A mantle stained by the blood of young virgins.        |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Mantle of Shivering                                    |
|                      A hunting mantle worn by the Darkness Clan. The tears  |
|                      and blood of the young virgins that were their prey    |
|                      have made a complex patter in the lining. Cuts         |
|                      Earth/Wind damage in half.                             |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Punk Jacket        |   73 /  77  |   10 /  11  | Halley                    |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A jacket perfect for outlaws.                          |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Punk Jacket                                            ||                      A leather jacket typically worn by street punks. The   |
|                      sharp metal spikes express their young rage.           |
|                      Reinforced with steel plates. Perfect for fighting.    |
|                      Cuts Wind damage in half.                              |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Metal Jacket       |   78 /  82  |   12 /  14  | Halley                    |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'———————————————————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A soul-screaming jacket.                               |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Metal Jacket                                           |
|                      A jacket made of thin sheet of heavy metal. Causes     |
|                      multiple fracture wounds to enemies when hit with      |
|                      bare hand. It's heavy, but shout and bear it. Cuts     |
|                      Earth damage in half.                                  |
'—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————'
